title: Prom and Group Chat
author: Ines Reyes
blurb: Edmund Villalobos, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
